items.question: Which ritual actions must replace hand-purification in the prescribed sequence?
premises: After discarding, an action is performed with the astra.
That action consists of performing three claps.
items.inference: The ritual sequence requires abandoning hand-purification and then performing three claps with the astra.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of kara-śuddhi in this context is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: One should discard the hand-purification; then, with the astra, one should perform three claps; then proceed.
